scope: Stage 4A/4B design only: no ERA5/ERA5-Land 2021-2023 download, no model training.
target_framing: Target remains the ERA5-Land reanalysis proxy — not observation.
frozen: Yelandur and Stage 1/2/3A/3B artifacts are read-only; their SHA-256 at design time is recorded below.

land_sea_4a.offline_status: NOT RESOLVABLE OFFLINE: no ERA5-Land land/sea information on disk (all local ERA5-Land files are inland with no missing values; no mask or coastline dataset present).

required_acquisition.decision_rule: cell is ERA5-Land land iff its 2m_temperature value is not missing (NaN)

land_sea_4a.applies_to: all flagged CONDITIONAL cells AND every expected cell of the selected Taluka Panchayats (gate)
land_sea_4a.effect_on_selection: none: CONDITIONAL Taluka Panchayats are ineligible; the selection is fixed and is not re-run after the mask unless a selected cell proves non-land

selection_procedure.objective: farthest-point (maximin) distance to Yelandur + already-selected centroids, per regime, in fixed regime order; ties: more cells, higher COMPLETE share, lower LGD code
selection_procedure.regime_source: regimes.py — project-authored conventional grouping, NOT an official agro-climatic zonation

bytes_per_grid_point_month.note: mean monthly NetCDF bytes per grid point, measured on the 72 Phase 2D files

acquisition_volume_estimate.note: Estimate only (per-Taluka request areas, 2021-2023). Not downloaded in this stage.

selected.land_sea_gate: all expected cells must be confirmed ERA5-Land land by the 4A mask request before acquisition

temporal_split.note: Identical to Phase 2D; applied inside every spatial fold.

fold_design.yelandur_role: frozen reference: never in any training set; evaluated as an extra reference region in every fold

district_holdout.reason: the selection allows one Taluka Panchayat per Zila Panchayat, so each district holdout removes exactly one selected Taluka Panchayat
